body:
Worker trap (Termal::BarA2, 2026-10-29; my own miss on Group B r9/r10, found by Merger2's intake check).

**The trap**
`termal_spawn_session` with a prompt like `/review-code Frozen tree X … read all six lens files` resolves the known slash command and SILENTLY DROPS everything after the command name.
- review-code.md has no `$ARGUMENTS`, and expandedPrompt substitutes only `$ARGUMENTS` (workspace_queries.rs:343).
- The child never sees your tree id or instructions.
- The stored delegation.prompt is the generic body.

**The rule**
- Put every reviewer instruction after ` -- `: `/review-code -- <instructions>`. That note is appended.
- Afterwards, verify with termal_get_session_status that the stored prompt ends with your note.
- Never claim in evidence that a prompt "names tree X" without reading the stored prompt.
- Tracked as w-03f5e1cd2f30.
